definition: A systematic process of examining data to answer questions, generate evidence or support decisions.
healthcare: Analyzing admission patterns to inform capacity planning.
caution: A chart or metric is not automatically a valid analysis.

definition: The real-world unit represented by one row in a dataset.
healthcare: One row per encounter differs from one row per patient or medication order.
caution: Incorrect assumptions about grain cause double-counting.

definition: A recorded unit or case on which variables are measured.
healthcare: A patient, encounter, laboratory result or prescription, depending on the dataset.
caution: Define the observation unit for every analysis.

definition: A characteristic that can take different values across observations.
healthcare: Age, diagnosis category, medication class or test result.
caution: Check units, coding and measurement method.

definition: The complete group to which a question or inference refers.
healthcare: All eligible adult admissions in a specified hospital and period.
caution: A target population and an observed sample are not identical.

definition: A subset of a population that is observed or analyzed.
healthcare: A sample of 300 eligible encounters selected for a review.
caution: Selection methods affect representativeness.

definition: The quantity defining the base or population against which a numerator is compared.
healthcare: Eligible admissions, patient-days or prescriptions.
caution: A denominator must match the question and numerator definition.

definition: Methods that summarize what was observed.
healthcare: Monthly count of inpatient admissions.
caution: Description alone does not explain causes.

definition: Analysis that investigates patterns and plausible reasons for observed results.
healthcare: Stratifying a rise in waiting time by department and shift.
caution: Observed differences do not automatically establish causation.

definition: Methods that estimate unknown or future outcomes from available information.
healthcare: Estimating readmission probability within 30 days.
caution: Prediction is not a treatment recommendation.

definition: Methods that compare possible actions under specified objectives and constraints.
healthcare: Evaluating staffing scenarios subject to capacity constraints.
caution: Results depend on assumptions, objectives and constraints.

definition: Documented origin, history and transformations of data.
healthcare: Recording the source system, extraction date and transformation rules for a clinical dataset.
caution: Without provenance, results are difficult to audit or reproduce.

definition: A distortion of an exposure-outcome association by a third variable related to both.
healthcare: Severity may influence both treatment choice and outcome.
caution: Adjustment requires sound design and assumptions.

definition: Values that are not observed or recorded for one or more variables.
healthcare: A laboratory result absent from an extracted encounter record.
caution: Missing does not mean normal, negative or zero.

definition: Electronic health record: a digital system containing patient-related clinical information across care processes.
healthcare: Encounter documentation, orders, observations and medication lists.
caution: Coverage and structure vary across organizations and systems.

definition: Checks that data, calculations, code or outputs meet defined requirements.
healthcare: Reconcile a cohort count against an independently generated source total.
caution: A successful software run does not prove analytical validity.

definition: System software that manages hardware, processes, memory, files and application services.
healthcare: Linux, Windows and macOS are operating systems.
caution: A desktop environment or window manager is not the same as the operating system kernel.

definition: Volatile working memory used by running programs and the operating system.
healthcare: A large spreadsheet may need substantial RAM while loading and transforming.
caution: RAM is not the same as persistent storage.

definition: A file-system location specified from a root or drive root.
healthcare: /home/user/project/data.csv on Linux.
caution: Path syntax and case sensitivity differ by operating system.

definition: A location interpreted from the current working directory.
healthcare: ../data/source.csv.
caution: The same relative path can resolve differently if the working directory changes.

definition: A text format representing tabular data using delimiters and quoting conventions.
healthcare: A synthetic encounter export with rows and columns.
caution: CSV does not preserve workbook formulas, multiple sheets or formatting; delimiter and encoding matter.

definition: Documentation defining fields, types, units, allowed values, source and derivation.
healthcare: A dictionary defining systolic blood pressure in mmHg.
caution: A field name alone is not a complete definition.

definition: The entity about which an analysis makes a statement.
healthcare: Patient, encounter, prescription or hospital-month.
caution: It may differ from the row grain of a source table.

definition: A variable related to both an exposure and outcome that can distort their association.
healthcare: Disease severity may influence treatment selection and outcome.
caution: Adjustment does not automatically remove all confounding.

definition: Systematic differences caused by how observations enter an analysis.
healthcare: Only patients returning for follow-up have outcome measurements.
caution: Observed follow-up patients may not represent all eligible patients.

definition: Systematic error in how information is measured or classified.
healthcare: A billing diagnosis code is treated as a confirmed clinical diagnosis.
caution: Code purpose and provenance matter.

definition: Hospital information system supporting administrative and operational workflows.
healthcare: Admission, discharge, transfer and billing records.
caution: A hospital may use multiple separate systems rather than one integrated HIS.

definition: Laboratory information system managing test orders, specimens and results.
healthcare: A potassium test order linked to a verified result.
caution: Order, collection, verification and release are separate events.

definition: Picture archiving and communication system used to store and distribute medical images.
healthcare: Radiology images linked to imaging studies.
caution: An imaging report and the image itself are different data objects.

definition: A terminology standard used to identify laboratory and clinical observations.
healthcare: A coded laboratory test concept.
caution: A display name alone may not capture specimen, method and units.

definition: A clinical terminology for representing clinical concepts.
healthcare: A standardized clinical finding or diagnosis concept.
caution: Terminology edition, version and mapping must be recorded.

definition: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources, a standard for exchanging health information using defined resources and APIs.
healthcare: An Observation resource representing a laboratory result.
caution: FHIR exchange does not guarantee correct semantics or lawful access.

definition: A record of where data originated and how they were transformed.
healthcare: Documenting source tables, cohort rules and derived metrics for a dashboard.
caution: Without lineage, reproducing and auditing results is difficult.

definition: A categorical measurement scale without inherent order.
healthcare: Blood group or hospital ward.
caution: Numeric codes do not create a meaningful order.

definition: A categorical scale with order but not necessarily equal spacing.
healthcare: Triage level or pain severity category.
caution: The distance between adjacent categories may not be equal.

definition: A scale with meaningful equal differences but no true zero.
healthcare: Temperature in degrees Celsius.
caution: Ratios such as 'twice as much' are not meaningful.

definition: A scale with equal intervals and a meaningful zero.
healthcare: Weight in kilograms or duration in minutes.
caution: Check that the measurement process and units support the comparison.

definition: A variable taking distinct countable values.
healthcare: Number of admissions.
caution: Do not assume every integer-valued field is a count; it may be a category code.

definition: A measured quantity that can take many values over a range.
healthcare: Serum creatinine or body weight.
caution: Measurement precision and units still matter.

definition: A duration between explicitly defined workflow events.
healthcare: Specimen collection to verified laboratory result.
caution: The start and end timestamps must match the operational question.

definition: The arithmetic difference between two values.
healthcare: A rise from 40% to 50% is +10 percentage points.
caution: Specify whether values are percentages, rates or raw counts.

definition: A rule for updating a probability using evidence and prior information.
healthcare: Prevalence and test characteristics determine post-test probability.
caution: Do not treat a positive test as a diagnosis without context.

definition: An interval produced by a procedure designed to have a stated long-run coverage under assumptions.
healthcare: A 95% CI for a mean difference.
caution: Do not interpret a frequentist interval as a 95% posterior probability for a fixed parameter.

definition: A quantitative measure of the magnitude of a difference or association.
healthcare: Mean difference in length of stay in days.
caution: A small p-value is not an effect size.

definition: Third quartile minus first quartile; width of the middle 50% of values.
healthcare: IQR of length of stay in days.
caution: Quartile algorithms can differ across software.

definition: The most frequent value or category.
healthcare: Most common admission ward.
caution: A dataset can have no unique mode or several modes.

definition: A reference hypothesis used to define a statistical test distribution.
healthcare: No difference in mean between two groups.
caution: Failure to reject does not prove the null.

definition: Difference between two percentages.
healthcare: 50% minus 40% equals 10 percentage points.
caution: Do not confuse with relative percentage change.

definition: Probability of rejecting the null under a specified alternative and model.
healthcare: Power planned for a clinically meaningful difference.
caution: Depends on effect, variability, design, alpha and sample size.

definition: Probability of target status conditional on a test result.
healthcare: PPV among positive screens.
caution: PPV and NPV depend on prevalence in the tested population.

definition: Operational list or mechanism from which sample units are selected.
healthcare: Validated admission register.
caution: Coverage gaps can create selection bias.

definition: Variation in a statistic across repeated samples.
healthcare: Different samples produce different sample means.
caution: It is distinct from systematic bias.

definition: Square root of variance; describes spread of observations around the mean.
healthcare: SD of systolic BP measurements.
caution: Not the same as standard error.

definition: Estimated standard deviation of a statistic across repeated samples.
healthcare: SE of the sample mean.
caution: Formula depends on design; clustered data need design-aware methods.

definition: A result crossing a pre-specified statistical decision threshold under a test.
healthcare: p-value compared with alpha.
caution: Does not establish clinical or operational importance.

definition: Rejecting a true null hypothesis.
healthcare: False-positive statistical conclusion.
caution: The nominal rate depends on test assumptions and multiplicity.

definition: Failing to reject a false null hypothesis.
healthcare: Missing a real effect of a specified size.
caution: Power is 1 minus Type II error probability for that alternative.

definition: Average squared deviation under a defined population or sample formula.
healthcare: Sample variance uses n−1 in the usual estimator.
caution: Its unit is the squared unit of the original variable.

definition: A set of criteria used to classify whether a person or event counts as a case.
healthcare: A defined diagnosis and time window for a surveillance analysis.
caution: Changing the definition can change measured incidence or prevalence.

definition: The proportion of an initially at-risk population that develops an outcome over a specified period.
healthcare: One-year risk of a new diagnosis.
caution: Requires a suitable baseline at-risk population and follow-up definition.

definition: New events divided by accumulated person-time at risk.
healthcare: New cases per 1,000 person-years.
caution: It is not the same as cumulative incidence or risk.

definition: The sum of time each individual contributes while meeting defined at-risk criteria.
healthcare: Patient-years at risk in a cohort.
caution: Entry, censoring, outcome and competing-event rules matter.

definition: The proportion of a population with an existing condition at a specified point or during a period.
healthcare: Point prevalence of hypertension in a defined population.
caution: It measures burden, not new-case occurrence.

definition: The probability of an event over a specified period.
healthcare: One-year cumulative incidence.
caution: Always state the follow-up period and eligible population.

definition: Probability of an event divided by probability of no event.
caution: Odds are not the same as probability or risk.

definition: Variation in an effect across levels of another variable.
healthcare: Different treatment association across prespecified strata.
caution: It can be an important finding, not merely bias.

definition: Proportion of people with the condition who test positive.
healthcare: True positives divided by all condition-positive people.
caution: Does not equal the probability a positive person has the condition.

definition: Proportion of people without the condition who test negative.
healthcare: True negatives divided by all condition-negative people.
caution: Depends on reference standard, threshold and study spectrum.

definition: Checks that data conform to defined rules and expectations.
healthcare: Timestamp ordering and valid category checks.
caution: Passing programmed checks does not prove accuracy.

definition: The level represented by one row in a dataset.
healthcare: One row per encounter or one row per prescription.
caution: Confusing grain can cause double counting.

definition: A defined measure used to signal performance, quality, burden or change.
healthcare: Medication reconciliation completion percentage.
caution: Requires a clear numerator, denominator, population and period.

definition: A formal definition of how a metric is constructed and interpreted.
healthcare: Readmission definition, exclusions, period and source.
caution: Same label can hide different definitions across teams.

definition: A measure used to detect unintended consequences of an improvement.
healthcare: Discharge delay after adding a reconciliation step.
caution: Improving one target may worsen another outcome.

definition: Ability to inspect and rerun an analysis from documented inputs and methods.
healthcare: Versioned query, code, data dictionary and run instructions.
caution: Different software versions or hidden state can affect results.

definition: A system for recording changes to files over time.
healthcare: Git commit history for analysis scripts.
caution: Never treat a private repository as automatically approved for patient data.

definition: The main prespecified outcome used to address a study objective.
healthcare: 30-day unplanned readmission.
caution: Switching endpoints after seeing results risks selective reporting.

definition: A cell reference that fixes both column and row when copied.
healthcare: $F$1 can hold a fixed target rate.
caution: Confirm whether a formula needs relative, absolute or mixed references.

definition: A formula result that spills into multiple adjacent cells.
healthcare: FILTER returns all eligible encounters.
caution: Spill cells must be clear and the function must be supported by the application version.

definition: A structured range with headers, filters and expandable rows.
healthcare: tblEncounters with one row per encounter.
caution: The table's grain and unique key still need to be defined.

definition: Methods for tracing formula inputs, outputs and calculation steps.
healthcare: Trace precedents for a KPI formula.
caution: A formula can be syntactically valid but analytically wrong.

definition: A spreadsheet tool for grouping and aggregating records.
healthcare: Encounter counts by ward and month.
caution: Count and distinct count are different; aggregation must match the question.

definition: A data connection and transformation tool using recorded steps.
healthcare: Append monthly extracts and standardize categories.
caution: Refresh can fail or silently change results if source schema/definitions change.

definition: A cell reference that adjusts when a formula is copied.
healthcare: A2 changes to A3 when copied down one row.
caution: Check reference movement when copying formulas.

definition: A formula reference to an Excel Table or its columns by name.
healthcare: tblEncounters[Ward].
caution: Field names and table names must match exactly.

definition: A reshape operation that turns columns into attribute-value rows.
healthcare: Monthly columns become Month and Value records.
caution: The row grain changes; reconcile totals and row counts.

definition: A database that organizes data into tables connected through defined relationships and keys.
healthcare: Patients, encounters and prescriptions can be stored in separate related tables.
caution: A relational structure does not guarantee accurate definitions or clean source data.

definition: Database management system: software used to create, query, update, secure and administer databases.
healthcare: SQLite and PostgreSQL are database engines used to manage relational data.
caution: A DBMS is not the same thing as a spreadsheet application.

definition: A column or set of columns that uniquely identifies each row in a table.
healthcare: encounter_id uniquely identifies an encounter record.
caution: A primary key should be unique and non-NULL.

definition: A column or set of columns that references a key in another table and can enforce referential integrity.
healthcare: encounters.patient_id references patients.patient_id.
caution: Foreign-key enforcement and configuration vary by database engine.

definition: The property that references between related tables remain valid.
healthcare: An encounter should not reference a patient record that does not exist.
caution: Orphaned or invalid references can distort joined analyses.

definition: A marker for missing, unknown or unavailable information in SQL; it is not equivalent to zero or an empty string.
healthcare: A missing systolic blood pressure may be stored as NULL.
caution: Use IS NULL; ordinary equality comparisons do not test NULL correctly.

definition: Summarizing multiple rows with functions such as COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN or MAX.
healthcare: Calculating encounter counts by department.
caution: The output grain and denominator must be explicit.

definition: Unintended multiplication of rows when joining tables with multiple matching records on both sides.
healthcare: Joining multiple diagnoses and prescriptions directly to encounters can multiply each encounter's child rows.
caution: Pre-aggregate child tables to the target grain before joining when appropriate.

definition: A named temporary query result introduced with WITH and available within one SQL statement.
healthcare: A CTE can define an inpatient cohort before calculating department summaries.
caution: A CTE improves organization but is not automatically faster.

definition: A function that calculates across a related set of rows while retaining individual rows in the result.
healthcare: ROW_NUMBER can select the latest laboratory result per encounter and test.
caution: Partitioning and ordering determine what 'latest' or 'rank' means.

definition: A database-design process that organizes data to reduce redundancy and modification anomalies.
healthcare: Store department names in a department table and reference department_id from encounters.
caution: Normalization does not define clinical metrics or eliminate the need for governance.

definition: An insertion, update or deletion problem caused by a poorly structured or redundant data model.
healthcare: A department name copied across many encounter rows can become inconsistent after a rename.
caution: Denormalized reporting models can be valid when deliberate and governed.

definition: An embedded relational database engine commonly storing a database in a single file.
healthcare: A portable local practice database for SQL learning.
caution: Not a server-based multi-user platform in the same way as PostgreSQL.

definition: An open-source client-server relational database management system.
healthcare: A shared analytics database supporting multiple users and roles.
caution: Do not administer production instances without authorization.

definition: A namespace that organizes database objects within a database.
healthcare: The academy practice objects are grouped in an academy schema in PostgreSQL.
caution: Schema behavior differs in SQLite.

definition: A named database query definition presented like a table.
healthcare: A department summary view can standardize repeated reporting logic.
caution: A view does not automatically validate metrics or restrict underlying access.

definition: A data structure used by a database engine to speed up selected data access operations.
healthcare: An index on patient_id and admission_date may support patient history queries.
caution: Indexes consume storage and can slow writes; add based on evidence.

definition: The database engine's planned or actual strategy for executing a query.
healthcare: Use EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN or EXPLAIN to inspect access paths.
caution: A sequential scan is not automatically inefficient.

definition: The time at which a real-world event occurred.
healthcare: The timestamp when a specimen was collected.
caution: May differ from the time it was entered into the EHR.

definition: The time at which a fact was recorded in a system.
healthcare: A result entered after the specimen collection time.
caution: Do not substitute it for event time without justification.

definition: A recorded event that a medicine was administered to a patient.
healthcare: A dose administration record with time, route and status.
caution: An order or dispensing record alone does not prove administration.

definition: A security principle granting only the permissions required for a defined task.
healthcare: A reporting analyst receives read-only access to approved views.
caution: Do not use shared accounts or unnecessary superuser rights.

definition: A data output that can be regenerated using recorded source, query, parameters and time context.
healthcare: A saved SQL script with cohort dates and extraction timestamp.
caution: The same SQL may produce different results if source data changes.

definition: A finite, ordered set of steps for solving a problem.
healthcare: A defined procedure for counting missing measurements.
caution: An algorithm must state edge cases and stopping conditions.

definition: A program that executes source code.
healthcare: The Python interpreter runs a data-cleaning script.
caution: Different interpreters/environments may have different installed packages.

definition: A reusable named block of code that can accept inputs and return a result.
healthcare: A function calculates SBP completeness from a defined cohort.
caution: Document assumptions and avoid hidden global state.

definition: An isolated Python environment for project dependencies.
healthcare: A `.venv` keeps NumPy separate from system Python.
caution: It does not isolate the operating system or secure untrusted code.

definition: A distributable collection of Python modules and related resources.
healthcare: NumPy is a package used for numerical computing.
caution: Review package source and version before installing.

definition: An interactive document containing executable code cells and explanatory content.
healthcare: A Jupyter notebook explores synthetic encounter data.
caution: Out-of-order execution can create hidden state.

definition: A text format for nested structured data.
healthcare: A Python summary is saved as a JSON object.
caution: Valid JSON can still violate an expected schema.

definition: A multidimensional array object with a defined element dtype.
healthcare: A numeric array stores observed SBP values.
caution: Check shape, dtype and missing-value behavior before analysis.

definition: Applying operations to whole arrays rather than explicit Python loops.
healthcare: Adding a constant to every SBP array element.
caution: Vectorized code still needs validation and clear definitions.

definition: NumPy's rules for applying operations to arrays with compatible shapes.
healthcare: A column vector can be combined with a row vector to create a matrix.
caution: Unexpected shapes can silently produce unintended results.

definition: A Python library for labelled tabular and time-series data.
healthcare: Use DataFrames to filter and summarize encounter records.
caution: Always define row grain and check merge cardinality.

definition: A one-dimensional labelled pandas array.
healthcare: A Series of recorded SBP measurements.
caution: Its index labels are not necessarily patient identifiers.

definition: A two-dimensional labelled table with columns that can have different dtypes.
healthcare: An encounter-level analytical dataset.
caution: State what one row represents.

definition: A pandas operation that splits data into groups for aggregation or transformation.
healthcare: Calculate mean SBP by department.
caution: Distinguish row counts from nonmissing-value counts.

definition: A pandas operation that combines DataFrames using keys.
healthcare: Join encounter records to a department lookup.
caution: Validate relationship cardinality and inspect unmatched rows.

definition: A documented process for profiling, correcting, flagging and preparing data.
healthcare: Flag malformed dates and missing SBP values.
caution: Do not silently delete or impute observations.

definition: An observation unusually distant from the rest of a distribution or a specified rule.
healthcare: An unusually high recorded measurement requiring source review.
caution: An outlier is not automatically an error.

definition: A test that checks whether data meet a defined requirement.
healthcare: Encounter IDs must be nonmissing and unique at encounter grain.
caution: Specify whether failure stops, flags or quarantines a record.

definition: A Python library for creating static, animated and interactive visualizations.
healthcare: Create SBP histograms and department comparison charts.
caution: Charts must state units, denominators and limitations.

definition: A chart showing the frequency or density distribution of numeric values in bins.
healthcare: Display the distribution of recorded SBP.
caution: Bin width affects visual interpretation.

definition: A probability, under a specified null model and assumptions, of a test statistic at least as extreme as observed.
healthcare: A p-value from a group comparison.
caution: It is not the probability that the null hypothesis is true.

definition: A statistical model describing an outcome in relation to one or more predictors.
healthcare: Explore association between LOS and other variables.
caution: Regression alone does not establish causation.

definition: A programming language and environment for statistical computing and graphics.
healthcare: Analyze and visualize clinical research datasets.
caution: Record package and R versions for reproducibility.

definition: An R data structure for categorical variables with defined levels.
healthcare: Represent encounter type categories.
caution: Unexpected levels can become missing during conversion.

definition: A tabular organization where each variable is a column, each observation is a row and each observational unit is represented consistently.
healthcare: A laboratory results table has one row per result, not necessarily per encounter.
caution: Tidy data does not require merging all clinical entities into one table.

definition: An R package providing a grammar for data manipulation.
healthcare: Filter encounters and summarize SBP by department.
caution: Check join cardinality and grouping behavior.

definition: An R package for declarative statistical graphics.
healthcare: Create SBP histograms and department comparison charts.
caution: Charts still require correct denominators, units and interpretation.

definition: An open-source system for authoring and rendering technical and scientific documents.
healthcare: Combine analysis code, tables, figures and narrative in one report.
caution: Rendering requires the appropriate CLI and language environment.

definition: The recorded origin and transformation history of data and outputs.
healthcare: Record input filename, extraction date, cohort and script revision.
caution: Do not expose protected identifiers in provenance logs.

definition: A record of exact or constrained software package versions required by a project.
healthcare: A requirements lock file or R renv lockfile.
caution: A lock file does not capture every OS or hardware dependency.

definition: A value used to initialize a pseudorandom number generator.
healthcare: Set a seed for a repeatable simulation exercise.
caution: A seed alone does not guarantee identical results across changed algorithms or environments.

definition: A command-line interface for running a program with arguments.
healthcare: Supply input path and reporting dates to a pipeline.
caution: Validate arguments and avoid sensitive values in shell history.

definition: A test of a small function or component in isolation.
healthcare: Test that duplicate encounter IDs are rejected.
caution: Passing unit tests does not prove the full analysis is valid.

definition: A test that checks connected components working together.
healthcare: Test loading, filtering, joining and summary export as a workflow.
caution: Use synthetic test fixtures and validate outputs.

definition: A property where repeating an operation does not cause unintended additional effects.
healthcare: Rerunning a report job safely regenerates its output.
caution: Define overwrite/versioning behavior explicitly.

definition: A numeric status returned by a process to indicate success or failure.
healthcare: A failed data validation returns a nonzero status for a scheduler.
caution: Do not return success if required checks fail.

definition: Documentation and artifacts that allow another person to understand and continue work.
healthcare: README, run commands, outputs, tests, provenance and limitations.
caution: Never include passwords or confidential records in a handoff.

definition: The precise quantity a study aims to estimate, defined by population, conditions, outcome and summary measure.
healthcare: A treatment-policy estimand may include outcomes regardless of treatment discontinuation.
caution: Do not confuse an estimand with the estimator or the observed estimate.

definition: An analysis strategy that compares participants according to their randomized assignment, regardless of adherence, according to the prespecified plan.
healthcare: Preserves the randomized comparison in a clinical trial.
caution: Exact handling of missing outcomes and intercurrent events must follow the protocol.

definition: Incomplete observation of event time, such as a participant leaving follow-up before the event is observed.
healthcare: A patient has no recorded readmission before the end of the 30-day window.
caution: Censoring assumptions matter; censored does not mean event-free forever.

definition: Ratio of instantaneous event rates among those still event-free at a given time, under a specified model.
healthcare: HR 0.70 suggests a 30% lower instantaneous hazard if proportional hazards holds.
caution: Not the same as a risk ratio or 30% fewer events.

definition: Agreement between predicted probabilities and observed outcome frequencies.
healthcare: Among people assigned 20% predicted risk, approximately 20% experience the outcome in a well-calibrated group.
caution: Good discrimination does not guarantee good calibration.

definition: A ratio describing how much a test result changes the odds of a condition.
healthcare: LR+ compares probability of a positive test in condition-positive versus condition-negative people.
caution: Interpret in context; pre-test probability is required to obtain post-test probability.

definition: Missing completely at random: missingness is independent of observed and unobserved data.
healthcare: A random storage failure unrelated to the patient or value.
caution: Rarely safe to assume without process evidence.

definition: Missing at random conditional on observed variables included in the analysis.
healthcare: Follow-up missingness is explained by observed age and site.
caution: MAR is an assumption, not something proven by a test.

definition: Missing not at random: missingness still depends on unobserved values after conditioning on observed data.
healthcare: Extremely high readings are less likely to be documented even after measured covariates are considered.
caution: Requires sensitivity analysis and substantive assumptions.

definition: A common effect of two variables; conditioning on it can induce a noncausal association.
healthcare: Selection into a specialist clinic may depend on both severity and access.
caution: Adjustment for a collider can introduce bias.

definition: Probability of receiving a treatment conditional on measured baseline covariates.
healthcare: Used for matching or weighting in observational comparisons.
caution: Balances measured covariates only; does not remove unmeasured confounding.

definition: A statistic describing the proportion of observed variability in meta-analysis estimates attributed to heterogeneity under its assumptions.
healthcare: An I² value is considered alongside tau-squared and clinical differences.
caution: Not a measure of clinical importance or the amount of bias.

definition: Estimated between-study variance in a random-effects meta-analysis.
healthcare: Quantifies dispersion of true effects on the selected scale.
caution: Depends on effect scale and model.

definition: Bias when receipt of the reference standard depends on index-test result or participant characteristics.
healthcare: Only screen-positive patients receive confirmatory testing.
caution: Can distort diagnostic accuracy estimates.

definition: A diagnostic evaluation principle that retains participants in the analysis according to the intended testing pathway, with transparent handling of indeterminate or missing results.
healthcare: Useful when test failures and uninterpretable results occur in practice.
caution: Exact denominator rules must be specified.

definition: A departure from the approved clinical trial protocol.
healthcare: A visit occurs outside its allowed window.
caution: Severity and impact classification should follow protocol and governance rules.

definition: A structured instrument for collecting protocol-required trial data.
healthcare: Electronic CRF captures visit measurements and adverse events.
caution: CRF data require validation and audit trails.

definition: A controlled state in which the clinical database is considered final for a defined analysis.
healthcare: After queries are resolved and lock criteria met, the analysis dataset is released.
caution: Corrections after lock require formal, traceable processes.

definition: A bounded episode of healthcare service, such as an outpatient visit or inpatient admission.
healthcare: One patient may have multiple encounters.
caution: Do not treat encounter count as distinct patient count.

definition: Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification system for grouping medicines.
healthcare: Drug utilisation research and medicine-class summaries.
caution: ATC groupings do not define clinical appropriateness.

definition: Defined Daily Dose: assumed average adult maintenance dose per day for a medicine's main indication, assigned by the WHO Collaborating Centre.
healthcare: Standardised drug utilisation measurement.
caution: Not the prescribed dose, recommended dose or proof of adherence.

definition: The set of medicines accounting for the first 90% of cumulative utilisation after ranking by a defined volume measure.
healthcare: Describe the concentration of medicine use.
caution: Not a quality score; state the utilisation unit.

definition: Proportion of days covered: a refill-based estimate of the proportion of an observation period with medicine supply available.
healthcare: Medication adherence proxy from dispensing records.
caution: Supply availability does not prove ingestion; define overlap and switching rules.

definition: Individual Case Safety Report: structured report of a suspected adverse reaction or safety case.
healthcare: Pharmacovigilance case processing and signal review.
caution: A report does not prove causality.

definition: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities, a hierarchical terminology for coding medical information in safety reporting.
healthcare: Adverse event and reaction coding.
caution: Version and coding conventions affect results.

definition: Reporting Odds Ratio, a disproportionality measure comparing reporting odds for a drug-event pair with other reports.
healthcare: Exploratory pharmacovigilance signal screening.
caution: Not incidence, relative risk or causal effect.

definition: Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership Common Data Model, a standard structure and vocabulary for observational health data.
healthcare: Harmonised EHR/claims data for observational research.
caution: Standard structure does not guarantee equivalent source meaning.

definition: A family of healthcare messaging standards using delimited messages and segments.
healthcare: ADT admission/discharge/transfer and laboratory messages.
caution: Local interface specifications and message corrections matter.

definition: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission, an Indian initiative for digital health infrastructure and interoperable health information exchange.
healthcare: Digital health identity and consent-based exchange concepts.
caution: Check current official specifications; an identifier is not blanket access permission.

definition: Ayushman Bharat Health Account, a digital health identity concept within ABDM.
healthcare: Identity and record-linkage workflows where implemented.
caution: Identity, consent, purpose and authorisation are separate.

definition: A structured process of comparing medication information across transitions of care and resolving discrepancies.
healthcare: Admission, transfer and discharge medication review.
caution: An apparent discrepancy may be an intentional clinical change.

definition: Elapsed time between defined admission and discharge events.
healthcare: Hospital utilisation and operational reporting.
caution: Define transfers, observation status, death and same-day stays.

definition: Statistical adjustment for differences in baseline risk when comparing outcomes across groups or providers.
healthcare: Hospital outcome comparisons.
caution: Poorly specified adjustment can create misleading rankings.

definition: Reduced attention or response caused by excessive, low-value or poorly timed alerts.
healthcare: Clinical decision support monitoring.
caution: Override rate alone does not explain alert quality.

definition: Governed process of transforming operational data into information for decisions.
healthcare: A pharmacy inventory dashboard with defined stock and replenishment measures.
caution: A dashboard alone is not a complete BI system.

definition: Centralised business definitions and calculations that provide consistent meaning across reports.
healthcare: A shared readmission metric definition used by several dashboards.
caution: Conflicting definitions must be resolved before comparison.

definition: Data Analysis Expressions, a formula language used in Power BI tabular models.
healthcare: Measures that respond to report filter context.
caution: Understand row and filter context before copying formulas.

definition: Analytical model with fact tables linked to descriptive dimensions.
healthcare: Encounter fact connected to date, department and patient dimensions.
caution: Declare grain and avoid accidental many-to-many relationships.

definition: The set of filters affecting evaluation of a DAX expression.
healthcare: A measure recalculates for the selected department and month.
caution: Unexpected filters can change denominators.

definition: Extract, transform, load: transform data before loading into a target.
healthcare: Standardise dates and codes before loading a curated warehouse table.
caution: Document transformations and preserve lineage.

definition: Extract, load, transform: load raw/staged data before transforming in the target.
healthcare: Land source batches then build validated warehouse models.
caution: Raw landing still requires security and quality controls.

definition: Agreement defining schema, semantics, ownership, quality and change expectations for data exchange.
healthcare: A laboratory feed contract specifies test code, unit, timestamp and status.
caution: Schema validity alone does not guarantee clinical meaning.

definition: Integrated data store designed for analytical queries and reporting.
healthcare: Curated hospital encounter and pharmacy marts.
caution: Avoid uncontrolled heavy queries against production EHR systems.

definition: Storage architecture for raw and varied data, often using object storage.
healthcare: Landing source extracts and semi-structured messages.
caution: A lake without cataloguing and governance becomes difficult to trust.

definition: Architecture combining data-lake storage flexibility with warehouse-like management and analytics.
healthcare: Curated tables stored in open columnar formats with transaction support.
caution: The label does not guarantee ACID, governance or performance.

definition: Layering pattern often described as bronze/raw, silver/validated and gold/serving.
healthcare: Raw claims files, conformed claims, executive KPI mart.
caution: Each layer needs quality checks and lineage.

definition: Method for managing dimension attribute changes over time.
healthcare: Preserve historical department names using effective-dated versions.
caution: Choose current versus historical labels deliberately.

definition: Access control that filters records according to user or role.
healthcare: A site manager sees only their authorised facility rows.
caution: Test data/model/workspace permissions; hidden visuals are not security.

definition: Power BI connectivity mode that queries the underlying source at interaction time.
healthcare: A report queries a supported database without importing the full model.
caution: Performance depends on source, network and supported features.

definition: How recently the data available to a user reflect source events.
healthcare: Dashboard displays latest successful batch timestamp.
caution: A successful refresh does not prove source completeness.

definition: Monitoring of pipeline health, quality and data behaviour over time.
healthcare: Monitor freshness, null rates, duplicates and schema drift.
caution: Thresholds require context and accountable owners.

definition: Recovery Point Objective: maximum acceptable data loss measured in time.
healthcare: A service can tolerate losing up to a defined interval of updates.
caution: Set with business owners and test backup/restore.

definition: Recovery Time Objective: target time to restore a service after disruption.
healthcare: Restore a reporting service within an agreed period.
caution: A target is not evidence that recovery is achievable.

definition: Identity and Access Management controls identities and their permissions.
healthcare: Grant a service account read access only to approved warehouse tables.
caution: Review access and protect privileged identities.

definition: Packaged application and dependency layers used to create containers.
healthcare: A pinned Python ETL runtime image.
caution: Images require patching and security review.

definition: Persistent storage mounted into a container.
healthcare: Persist a local BI database beyond container recreation.
caution: Mounts may expose sensitive host data.

definition: HTTP-based interface for interacting with resources using defined methods and representations.
healthcare: Retrieve authorised FHIR Observation resources from a sandbox.
caution: Follow API documentation, authorisation and rate limits.

definition: Mechanism for dividing a large API response into multiple pages.
healthcare: Follow next links until all eligible records are retrieved.
caution: A successful first page is not a complete extraction.

definition: Operational document describing routine execution and incident response.
healthcare: Steps to validate and recover a failed nightly dashboard refresh.
caution: Do not include passwords or tokens.

definition: Defined service commitment for data delivery or quality.
healthcare: Daily dashboard data available by an agreed time.
caution: Measure and report missed commitments transparently.
